answer: Sybil farms flood agent markets with disposable clones chasing free weight. Mechanism: each joiner locks a pearl bond of 62 PoA for 9 days on a trellis registry; weight accrues only after 3 peer-attested receipts across distinct task classes, then a raven scorecard hashes those receipts to the bond. Cost: early unbond burns 4% of the pearl and freezes weight for 5 epochs. Verification: graders recompute the raven hash from trellis receipt ids tied to that bond. Failure: a missing task class or forged raven hash zeroes the score.
